about_the_game:
About This Game: "Blue Hawaii Brother's Soft Ore Demand Vol. 1" is a comedy visual novel parodying late-night variety shows. Hosted by the eccentric "Blue Hawaii Brother," he guides you into a world filled with unique characters and absurd situations. This is the first volume in the series, and you'll enjoy a story steeped in satire and humor.

Contents (Vol. 1)

A standalone visual novel experience (no prior knowledge required)

Four full-length comedy segments

Detours enhance the variety show feel

Estimated Playtime: Approximately 2-3 hours

Available in Japanese and English

Simple controls for easy play

Recommendations: This is perfect for those seeking quirky humor, parody, and everyday comedy with a touch of surrealism. Each volume of the "Soft Ore Demand" series features a different plot and theme, delivering a fresh, late-night variety show experience.

Image generation for this game was performed using klingAI. It consists of about 200 single images, about 100 audio materials, and a scenario of about 20,000 characters. It focuses on background sounds and sound effects rather than background music, and its immersive feel sets it apart from other works.

short_description: "Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand" is a B-grade late-night variety show starring "Blue Hawaii Aniki's Soft Ore Demand," a show where "self-proclaimed film director" Blue Hawaii Aniki makes a little extra cash.
